changes: ✨ **A duplicate account name is caught while you type** — the name is checked against every account and tenant already on the list, so the clash is shown under the field instead of after the whole form is filled in. The server still refuses one either way.

✨ **Ask Paul cannot be licensed without a database** — it is the only module with a per-tenant database, and licensing it without one produced a hand-off into an app with nothing behind it. The tick is now tied to the database, on the create form, the list pill and the traceability dialog alike. Turning it off is never blocked.

🐛 **Modules ticked on the create form were dropped when a database was provisioned** — only the no-database path ever wrote them. They now travel with the job and are applied once the account row exists.

🐛 **Creating an account without a database failed** — the insert left out four columns the accounts table requires, so it was rejected with a not-null violation. 0.3.0's whole point did not work; this is the fix.
✨ **Create an account without a database** — pick the modules it is licensed for and the account exists immediately. Only Ask Paul needs a per-tenant database; Traceability and Training never did.
✨ **Modules chosen at creation** — Traceability, Training and Ask Paul are ticked on the create form and written to the tenant licence row, instead of being set afterwards one pill at a time.

🐛 **Provisioning could never succeed on Vercel** — the schema step dials `db.<ref>.supabase.co`, which has no IPv4 address, so it failed with a DNS error after creating a real billable project. Provisioning is now opt-in and off by default, and the form says what it costs.
✨ **Version in the footer** — the sidebar now shows the running version; click it for the release notes.
✨ **Release notes** — this file, plus a long-form changelog in `docs/changelog/CHANGELOG-v0.md`.
🔄 **CLAUDE.md trimmed** — ten releases of inline history moved to the changelog, leaving the current-version block and a pointer.
🔄 **Orcanos hosts only** — sign-in URLs are now restricted to `orcanos.com` and its subdomains by default, which is what makes the free-text URL box safe.
🐛 **Wrong Orcanos identity** — the platform admin row still carried test data, so every password was being checked against the wrong Orcanos user.
✨ **Choose the Orcanos server** — the sign-in screen now has an Orcanos URL field, remembered per browser.
✨ **A real default** — `ORCANOS_LOGIN_URL` (`app.orcanos.com/orcanos`); an unset `orcanos_api_url` used to be a 500.
🔄 **Richer login audit** — every sign-in event records which Orcanos server answered, and whether the caller chose it.
✨ **Sign in by username** — the first field now accepts an Orcanos user name as well as an email address.
✨ **Show/hide password** — a toggle on the password field.
🗑️ **Microsoft sign-in withdrawn** — it trusted an email attribute an attacker can set in their own tenant; off in code, not just hidden.
🔄 **Google and Orcanos sign-in unaffected** — each method resolves independently.
🗑️ **Status column removed** — it was never a platform gate; an account set Inactive could still sign in to traceability.
🔄 **Ask Paul writes both halves** — one pill now sets the master flag and the traceability licence, and ANDs them for display.
🔄 **Security audit and hardening** — full review of the tree, recorded in `SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-08-29.md`.
🐛 **SSRF guard gaps** — IPv4-mapped IPv6 spellings of loopback walked past the address check; CGNAT space is now blocked too.
🐛 **Console was framable** — security headers added, chiefly `frame-ancestors 'none'`.
🐛 **Google sign-in now requires `email_verified`** — the email domain is half the platform gate.
✨ **Orcanos mark** — the logo now appears on the sidebar brand and the login card.
🔄 **QMS AI pill is now Ask Paul** — and reads the real licence column instead of being derived from account status.
🐛 **Version mismatch** — `package.json` said 0.1.1 while the docs said 0.2.0.
✨ **Orcanos-backed sign-in** — email sign-in verifies the password through Orcanos `QW_Login` instead of a stored hash.
🐛 **Tenant pin corrected** — it compared against the config-row label rather than the account's real Orcanos tenant segment.
🐛 **Google sign-in fixed** — first live run against the master database; two never-applied migrations found.
